notes.title: Hotfix #7
notes.content:

Enjoy the game! 🎮

notes.title: ❄️ Big Update: The Ice World Awaits!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, space explorers! 🌌
We’ve got huge news — the story update for Digger: Galactic Treasures is here![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve added a continuation of the storyline and an entirely new location — the Ice World.
Here’s what’s waiting for you:[/p][p][/p][p]✨ Brand-new artifacts[/p][p]💎 Unique resources[/p][p]🧩 New achievements[/p][p]⚒ A new mining tool[/p][p]💣 For hardcore players — the powerful [b]Annihilator Bomb[/b][/p][p]🔦 A brighter and more convenient flashlight[/p][p]🎆 New explosion sounds to boost the thrill[/p][p]🪐 Improved asteroid materials and overall graphics[/p][p]🔧 Better physics to make digging and exploring even smoother[/p][p]⚡ Optimization and lots of small fixes[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582515/cd864aa4bda7c88509cee27a506e02675d85a9da.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who keeps playing, sharing feedback, and helping us grow the game!
The Ice World is waiting for its first pioneers ❄🚀[/p][p][/p][p]See you among the stars, friends! 🌠[/p]

tags.feature: - We’ve added a continuation of the storyline and an entirely new location — the Ice World.
✨ Brand-new artifacts
💎 Unique resources
🧩 New achievements
⚒ A new mining tool
💣 For hardcore players — the powerful [b]Annihilator Bomb[/b]
🔦 A brighter and more convenient flashlight
🎆 New explosion sounds to boost the thrill
🪐 Improved asteroid materials and overall graphics
🔧 Better physics to make digging and exploring even smoother

tags.bug: ⚡ Optimization and lots of small fixes

notes.title: Hotfix #5
notes.content:
Added an option to enable or disable planetary gravity for the player (if you find it difficult, you can turn this mechanic off).

Fixed loading/saving of artifacts in the bonus level (unfortunately, if your artifacts disappeared, you will have to start over).

Added protection against FPS drops in the bonus level during explosions.

Added translations for artifacts.

Fixed translations in some areas.

Known issues:
The Infinite Tunnel is not truly infinite — after around 120 units, the ground stops appearing (although the tunnel itself continues).

notes.title: Update: New Bonus Level and Tons of Improvements!
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 [b]The Big Friday Update is Here![/b][/h2][p]Hello galactic explorers! 🌌[/p][p]Exciting news — the [b]Big Friday Update[/b] has landed! We know many of you were waiting. Here are all the key improvements and surprises:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌟 New & Important:[/h3][list][*][p]🆕 [b]A new bonus level has been added[/b], shedding light on the story and cosmic mysteries.
Many thought it was the end… of course not! There's more truth to dig up![/p][/*][*][p]⚙ [b]Discover new artifacts, bunkers, and secrets[/b] within this level.[/p][/*][*][p]💡 [b]The Infinite Tunnel[/b] has been added… try digging it — but tread carefully![/p][/*][*][p]⛏ [b]A powerful new drilling tool[/b] is now available![/p][/*][*][p]🎨 [b]Art enhancements[/b] across various models and environments — now even more beautiful![/p][/*][*][p]🛸 [b]FOV adjustment added[/b] — customize your field of view![/p][/*][*][p]💥 [b]MiniNuke effect enhanced[/b] — now even more explosive and impressive![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Gameplay Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]⛏ [b]Increased digging speed[/b] when holding the button on hand tools
[i](clicking is still slightly faster)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]💡 [b]Placed lamps improved[/b]:
increased lighting radius and optimized behavior[/p][/*][*][p]⚙ [b]Collector upgrade[/b]: items now auto-pickup from a larger radius — less running around![/p][/*][*][p]🔭 [b]Observatory now shows ...error... sign[/b]
marking the area as inaccessible... or just raising more questions? 👀[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Fixes & Stability:[/h3][list][*][p]🧱 [b]Critical voxel-loading bug fixed[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🧲 [b]Added protection against getting stuck in geometry[/b] — player will now return to the ship[/p][/*][*][p]🔧 Plus numerous [b]minor tweaks and bug fixes[/b] throughout the game!


Thank you for playing, sharing feedback, and helping us improve the game![/p][p][b]See you in the depths of space![/b] 💎🌠[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ✅ Steam Deck Compatibility Confirmed!
notes.content: [h2]Friends, great news![/h2][p]We've received official confirmation from Valve: [b]Digger: Galactic Treasures[/b] is fully compatible with Steam Deck! 🎮🚀[/p][p]The game runs smoothly at 60 FPS, controls are well adapted for the handheld console, and the gameplay is perfect for relaxed play on the go, on the couch, or anywhere you like.[/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who tested and provided feedback — you helped us achieve this milestone![/p][p]See you among the stars! 🌌✨[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45582515/541dfd7f09c6b2b5c9e1196d19deae7fdf141e71.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Digger: Galactic Treasures is out now! 🚀
notes.content:
[h3][b]Friends, the big day has come — Digger: Galactic Treasures is officially released![/b][/h3][p]Huge thanks to everyone who participated in the playtest, tried the demo, wrote reviews, and shared your thoughts — your support helped us tremendously. Thanks to you, we were able to:[/p][p]🔧 Fix countless bugs
🛠 Improve performance
🌌 Refine game balance and mechanics
🎨 Add new visual polish
📢 Attract new players to our small corner of space[/p][p]We’ve done a ton of work and we’re proud to finally share it with you![/p][p]Thank you, friends! Happy release day to all! 💙
See you among the stars! ✨[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Full list of improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed all collision issues[/p][/*][*][p]Added colorblind mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added shop tips for all items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “pick up item” text display for some languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mass of large collectible item[/p][/*][*][p]Added tip about gravity asteroid flight[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed translations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shop UI[/p][/*][*][p]Added digging physics[/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 free dynamite stick after buying dynamite upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed saving/loading of ship inventory items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed standing in tight spaces[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed saving of air generator and lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Added total sales info[/p][/*][*][p]Increased post-upgrade oxygen reserve time[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to skip text sequences[/p][/*][*][p]Added control inversion option[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the game![/p]
